name: The River Delta
gloss: Silt, flood, and three harvests a year. Small, and worth more than everything around it.

name: The Arable Lowland
gloss: The ordinary country most people live in, and the reason there are most people.

name: The Upland Pasture
gloss: Thin soil that carries herds rather than fields.

name: The Deep Forest
gloss: Timber and game, and a long walk to either.

name: The Highland Waste
gloss: Rock, weather, and the occasional stubborn holdfast.
